$comment: Layer-to-Glob mapping table — the canonical translation from `scope.language` + `scope.layers[]` (per `source-rule.schema.json`) into the file-pattern `globs` array that the Phase-4 Cursor MDC transformer emits. KEYS: each top-level key (excluding `$schema`, `$id`, `$comment`) is a language identifier; each second-level key is a layer identifier; each value is an array of glob patterns. SEMANTICS: an empty array on the `architecture` layer is a sentinel meaning `the compiler routes this rule to alwaysApply:true` (architecture rules cross-cut every file). An empty array on any OTHER layer means `no idiomatic file pattern is defined for this layer in this language`; the compiler falls back to the language's `all` glob. EXTENSION POLICY: the Phase 2 baseline reproduces `docs/02-implementation-plan.md` §5 task 2 verbatim (Java fully specified there; TypeScript and Python as a sample). Phase 3 / Phase 5 / Phase 8 may extend this file with additional layers, languages, or globs subject to Standards-Architect approval per `.github/CODEOWNERS`. The `_global` pseudo-language is NOT present here because cross-cutting rules under `source/_global/` use `activation.cursor_mode: always` and never need glob resolution.

$comment_layers.controller: REST/web controllers — Spring MVC `@RestController`, `@Controller`, and the conventional `controller/`, `web/`, `rest/` packages. Used by Logic Hole #3 (validation + DTO records) and the controller half of Logic Hole #5 (pagination defaults).
$comment_layers.service: Service-layer beans — `@Service`-annotated classes and the conventional `service/`, `usecase/` packages. Used by Logic Hole #4 (transactional discipline + self-invocation).
$comment_layers.repository: Spring Data repositories and JDBC-direct DAOs — `@Repository` and the conventional `repository/`, `dao/`, `persistence/` packages. Used by Logic Hole #4 (N+1 prevention, entity graph strategy) and the repository half of Logic Hole #5 (no naked findAll).
$comment_layers.config: Java `@Configuration` classes plus the Spring Boot `application*.yml`/`.properties` family. Used by config-only rules such as `disable-open-session-in-view` and actuator security.
$comment_layers.test: JUnit test classes — file-name-based detection (`*Test.java`, `*Tests.java`, `*IT.java` for integration tests). Distinct from the source-tree `testing/` directory which is the AUTHORING layer for testing rules.
$comment_layers.di: Dependency-injection rules apply broadly — every Java file may contain a Spring-managed bean. Logic Hole #6 (constructor injection mandate) uses this layer; the resulting MDC is `agent-requested` mode so it does not always-attach.
$comment_layers.error-handling: Exception/advice/error packages. Used by the existing baseline rules (prohibit-generic-runtime, prohibit-blind-catch) plus the unified-api-error rule.
$comment_layers.architecture: Empty by design — sentinel for the compiler. Architecture rules cross-cut every file and emit MDC with `alwaysApply: true`, no globs.
$comment_layers.all: Catch-all — every Java source. Used when a rule applies to any Java code regardless of layer (rare; agent-requested mode is usually a better fit).

$comment_layers.controller: NestJS-style controllers — file-name suffix `.controller.ts` is the dominant idiom (the framework's CLI scaffolds files this way). Phase 3+ may extend this list if other TypeScript frameworks (e.g., Express, Hono) become first-class.
$comment_layers.all: Catch-all — every TypeScript and TSX source. Phase 3+ will extend this map with `repository`, `config`, `test`, `di`, `error-handling`, and `architecture` entries as TypeScript Logic Holes are added; the current Phase 2 baseline reproduces `docs/02-implementation-plan.md` §5 task 2 verbatim.

$comment_layers.controller: FastAPI router modules — the convention is a top-level `routers/` package OR an `api/` package; both are matched.
$comment_layers.service: FastAPI service modules — the convention is a `services/` package.
$comment_layers.all: Catch-all — every Python source. Phase 3+ will extend this map with `repository`, `config`, `test`, and other layers as Python Logic Holes are added; the current Phase 2 baseline reproduces `docs/02-implementation-plan.md` §5 task 2 verbatim.
